text: The analytics dashboard UI is intuitive and modern, making reporting a breeze. However, we keep experiencing severe latency during peak hours and the CSV export crashes frequently. Please fix this bug!
Seamless onboarding and great documentation! The automated sync integration with Slack saved our team 10 hours a week. Fantastic product.

We were hit with unexpected hidden charges on our subscription renewal. When we disputed the billing fee, customer support was unresponsive for 4 days. Seriously considering switching to a competitor.
Love the core functionality, but it would be great if you could add customizable email alerts. Currently missing granular filter options.
Frequent downtime during our monthly close. The software froze and resulted in data loss for our reconciliations. Unacceptable stability for an enterprise tier price.
The fastest workflow builder on the market. Super responsive interface, zero learning curve, and the customer support rep walked us through everything.
